method: Read-only canonical registries, render dispatch, imports, named component scan and historical evidence review. No browser/test/CI execution or product mutation performed. Inline overlays grouped; not exhaustive of every possible state.
ci_caveat: 507/87 global passing counts supplied by coordination do not map to a panel/viewport or certify visual/human acceptance; not distributed across units. Test reference lists are text matches, never execution claims.

gap_policy.zoom: Only cited local native-zoom subsets; no IDE/admin-wide200% evidence. Pinch not nativezoom.
gap_policy.coverage_definition: Evidence counts are observations/cases/groups, not deduplicated user journeys. Shared proof may support several inventory rows; never sum row counts.

/projects/:projectId/git.note: GET redirect preserves other search parameters; view=git, not guessed panel=

/projects/:projectId/deployments.note: Legacy POST actions retained; not a second modern publishing UI

/projects/:projectId/domains.note: GET redirect; legacy POST/error boundary retained

standalone-admin.note: setSectionId state, do not expand sections into guessed routes

ide-debugger.scope: Node Inspector real local process + synthetic workspace; browser breakpoint/pause/variables/stopped at390/820/1440, use receipt for exact states; not Kubernetes/production

ide-publish-preview.scope: 6 targeted Preview/Publish cases, 0 retries; provider operations intercepted; not all IDE panels or current commit acceptance

ide-domains.scope: Canonical Domains routing/bookmarks/legacy form errors; reserved owner evidence, not rerun

account-dialog.scope: 88 observations plus8interaction groups across data/connected; deletion dialogue cancel only; no production

dashboard-grid.scope: Templates/Recent88geometry,6interaction groups,24count+24numericvisibility,8nativezoom; two-line clamp preserved. Not all dashboard widgets.

templates.scope: Same run as dashboard-grid, do not add counts twice. No template creation/import executed.

palette.scope: Dashboard and page palette40observations/8keyboard groups on historical build; exact final spacing receipts in linked directory

workspace.scope: Workspace within176geometry/8interaction/16nativezoom grouped support+desktop run;4targeted contrast replay observations,148eligible text measurements; simulated bridge is not Electron

public-nav.scope: Public header/footer, Escape/close/resize1279→1280, RTL and nativezoom; receipts split by build, not IDE mobile navigation

security-dialog.scope: Session confirmation open/Tab/Escape,4groups;88geometry+8nativezoom across2security routes; no revoke/MFA/token mutation
